story.headline: 79% moved the same way
story.text: 1759 of 2226 stocks fell today (79%), with the median stock at -1.86%. The most one-sided sector was Financial Services: 130 of 154 names fell, averaging -1.64%. The least one-sided was Healthcare at -1.01% on average. A day this one-sided is about the whole market rather than any single company - stock-specific news rarely moves nine in ten names the same way.
